items.description: The Watcher prompt and campaign roadmap required Application Client consumer integration before future Watcher runtime launch, but the Watcher graph named only client-conformance.
items.rationale: The gate is a pre-product exact-revision attestation over completed public conformance evidence. It does not require Watcher runtime implementation, so client-conformance -> consumer-integration-gate -> watcher-runtime-core is acyclic. Retaining both external edges preserves explicit conformance and gate blocker truth.
items.terminalPath: Completed atomically when this disposition and watcher-runtime-core's external dependency on application-client/consumer-integration-gate land together in the combined client-conformance-shaping-152-v1 reconciliation packet.
items.dispositionAuthority: Campaign session e06813c4-1db2-4d77-b8d3-3addc6a1824c accepted the joint Watcher, Application Client, and Operator Station adjudication watcher-runtime-consumer-gate-adjudication-v1.

evidence.details: The prompt says watcher-runtime-core remains planned until Application Client client-conformance and the consumer-integration gate permit it.
watcher-runtime-core depends on dumb-watcher-contract-gate and externally on Application Client client-conformance; it does not name consumer-integration-gate.

The roadmap keeps both consumer runtimes blocked through conformance and the consumer-integration gate, and keeps watcher-runtime-core planned until client-conformance proves the required cross-backend behavior.

Watcher, Application Client, and Operator Station authorities agreed that consumer-integration-gate is a pre-product exact-revision public-client consumability attestation after conformance. Watcher runtime implementation is not gate evidence.

Issue #152 owns one public-only cross-backend conformance bundle with Watcher-shaped send-only and Operator Station-shaped bidirectional probes. Both consumer authorities attest the same exact reviewed and green head before the gate is operated.

completionEvidence.gateBoundary: Public conformance evidence plus exact-revision consumer attestations; no Watcher runtime implementation.
